task: Fix _is_cli_request in proxy_router.py and LLMProxyMonitoringService to classify requests by client_type instead of X-CodeMie-CLI header presence, so Chrome extension traffic is routed to BudgetCategory.PLATFORM.

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: Budget classification is spend-sensitive; incorrect predicate misroutes CLI vs PLATFORM billing
technical_risk.mitigation: Change is a single dict-key lookup replacement in each predicate; existing pattern (client_type checks) already used in _resolve_non_premium_tracking_identity; new tests directly cover Chrome extension edge case

key_reasoning.reason: Two parallel one-liner fixes in sibling components (proxy_router and LLMProxyMonitoringService); no new abstractions, no cross-layer coordination needed

Budget classification is spend-sensitive, but the change swaps one header-presence check for an existing client_type lookup — the same pattern already governs _resolve_non_premium_tracking_identity; new test class guards the Chrome extension edge case explicitly
